segments.name: Stran & Company, Inc.
segments.description: Outsourced marketing solutions and promotional products provider for customers across a variety of industries.
segments.evidence: The Stran segment's business is focused on being an outsourced marketing solutions and promotional products provider for a variety of customers and industries, working closely with customers to develop sophisticated marketing programs that leverage Stran's promotional products and loyalty incentive expertise.

segments.name: Stran Loyalty Solutions
segments.description: Reportable segment serving SLS customers with tailored merchandise and marketing solutions for recurring revenues.
segments.evidence: The Company operates in two reportable segments: Stran & Company, Inc. and Stran Loyalty Solutions.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay for finished promotional products that the company buys from third-party manufacturers and decorators and resells to them.
revenueModel.evidence: Stran purchases products and branding through various third-party manufacturers and decorators and resells the finished goods to customers.

changes.text: In 2024 the company began reporting two reportable segments after it acquired Stran Loyalty Solutions.
changes.evidence: The Stran segment's operations have remained consistent for all periods presented, however, the Company only had one operating and reportable segment prior to the acquisition.
